{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices consistently exceed model predictions by 1-3 euros",
    "Lag effect: model predictions trail behind price momentum, especially during upticks",
    "Sentiment strength directly correlates with forecast accuracy - high sentiment (1.0) regions show least deviation",
    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains levels too tightly, allowing more volatility than predicted",
    "When history shows clear upward trend, model under-forecasts by ~2-3 euros relative to true trajectory",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative portends model under-forecasting the decline",
    "Model fails to capture price inflection points where sentiment shifts abruptly" ]}
